Athlete mode — phone flow, v3
The use case: the official plan says you miss your train; a sprint route lets you still make it. Search a trip as usual; when a shortcut exists, a 'You can still make the 17:32' card sits above the normal connections. Try it → sheet (full sprint 3:00 · 1:00 spare · walking impossible) → optional map of the run → sprint route detail → Go live. No pace tiers: one calibrated sprint pace in settings (3.5 m/s default, learned from timed runs). The official plan is never hidden.
Map: OpenStreetMap tiles with the run drawn from OSM node coordinates in the research. Original UI, no SBB branding or components copied.
Numbers: 460 m from Central to the hall, official 9:00 walk budget. 'SOON' chips mark phase-2 items (Strava, crowd timing).
